absent: Real implementations behind fallback helpers when full support is enabled.
Locking and reference counting rules for lookup power management and driver registration beyond the debug mutex.
Configuration space access semantics outside fallback reporting.
Fixup section iteration matching logic and ordering guarantees across passes.
Virtualization provisioning and resource sizing behavior beyond fallback codes.
Product data parsing validation and checksum handling.
Link power and time measurement hardware interaction sequences.

findings.text: Fallback link power controls report success without changing hardware state, while support and enable queries report negative and the global disable helper does nothing.
Hotplug link change ignore controls are inert and error reporting availability reports unavailable.

Time measurement operation table groups capability check, context update and validity access, local and master clock access, four timestamp reads, and per attribute visibility predicates, each receiving opaque driver data plus result storage.
Time measurement debug state bundles a filesystem handle, a pointer to the operation table, a mutual exclusion member, and opaque private data.
The debug state carries its own mutual exclusion member alongside the operation table pointer and private data, so debug activation uses that member for serialization.
Time measurement enable reports invalid argument, disable and destroy do nothing, enabled query reports false, and creation reports absence.
Domain number helpers either expose the number stored in the bus object or report zero, with the firmware variant fixed at zero.
Architecture display decode hook is a callback receiving a device and a decode enable flag and returning status.
Input output and memory region request and release helpers choose bars matching the requested resource kind then delegate to the selected region primitives.
Global flag manipulation helpers in this view have no effect and flag query always reports clear.
Configuration space fallback generator provides narrow middle and wide accessors that uniformly report function not supported.
Discovery enumeration presence driver registration capability location and serial number helpers in fallback form return absence or success without action, with reference release as no operation.

Activation master control resource assignment power state wake and region management fallbacks use fixed outcomes such as input output error busy invalid argument no space and default active power state.

Bus and slot lookup interrupt translation matching and vector helpers report absence or invalid argument, address translation reports all bits set, access control reports disabled, translation service reports disabled, and suspend context is reported retained with zero interrupt type.

Resource helpers derive start end flags and length from the indexed slot of the device, treat zero end as empty, classify slots by kind, and iterate across the full slot count with optional index exposure.
Driver data access and device naming delegate to the embedded generic device object.

Fixup descriptor carries selectors for vendor identity device identity class code and shift amount plus a hook reference whose representation depends on relocation support, and the pass enumeration orders lifecycle points from early probing through header final enable and suspend resume variants.

Fixup declaration helpers emit per phase section entries keyed by vendor device class or wildcard class, with one variant routing through a generated stub and another emitting a static descriptor directly, while the runtime dispatcher in this view does nothing.
Context update mode values distinguish automatic as zero and manual as one.
Bridge compatibility flags use ascending powers of two from one through sixty four covering direct memory access failure, named chipset workarounds, low latency need, and graphics aperture failure.

Product data tags mark large resources with top bit set and identify string read only and read write payloads, with read only keywords for part number serial number manufacturer vendor zero and checksum.
Architecture mapping capability checks report unavailable, bus bar mapping reports invalid argument, and root bus firmware handle reports absence.

Express capability helpers expose the cached offset and flags, derive presence and type from those cached values, and locate the enclosing root port by walking upstream bridges until a root port type is found.
Device disconnect determination observes the latched error state with single read semantics and treats only permanent input output failure as disconnected.

Virtualization helpers in fallback form report not implemented or missing device for identifier bus and function location enablement and link operations, report zero counts and sizes, and leave disable removal and autoprobe control inert with null simple configuration.
Platform hooks for interrupt penalty and mapped configuration early and late initialization do nothing in this view.

Fallback helpers that unconditionally report success or absence can mask missing feature support if callers do not check configuration, since enable register power and lookup operations appear to succeed or cleanly miss.
Single read accessor owned by another dossier.
